goal: Price a site's pay (city minimum wage, premiums) into the roster with legally correct weighted-average overtime, and measure what it changes.
notes: Landed --site-wage (page field 'Wages by site'): +$/h, +%, min floor per site; overtime on the weighted-average regular rate (29 CFR 778.115). Exact-check floors adjusted for mixed rates (person's least rate for list floors; per-shift pricer floor h*(r - c*(high-r))); brute-force test over 6 tiny random weeks never beats a proven roster. eval/site-wages.mjs on 40 made-up weeks (City $21.30 Seattle 2026 floor, Suburb $17.13 WA 2026 floor, from lni.wa.gov): unpriced roster understated payroll ~5.4%; pricing saved 2.2% (f=1, cheaper in 40/40) and 0.65% (f=0.5, 35 cheaper, 4 same, 1 dearer by $6.64).
